chapters.name: Babi na 1: Karanta majiyoyi da yadda gwamnati ke aiki

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Yadda jarabawar GED ta Social Studies ke aiki
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Jera sassa da kayan aikin jarabawar GED ta Social Studies, da rubuta tsarin karatu mai ranaku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da shafin GED na hukuma, za ku iya jera sassa, nau'o'in tambayoyi, lokaci da kayan aikin jarabawar GED ta Social Studies, da rubuta tsarin karatu mai ranaku, an ambaci dukkan fannonin ƙwarewa uku, da aƙalla ranar karatu ɗaya a kowane mako har zuwa jarabawar.
GED tana da jarabawowi huɗu: Lissafi (Math), Harshe (Reasoning Through Language Arts), Kimiyya (Science) da Nazarin Zamantakewa (Social Studies). Kuna iya zama su ɗaya bayan ɗaya. GED Testing Service ce ke yin jarabawar. Wasu jihohi suna amfani da wata jarabawar daidai da sakandare, HiSET, don haka ku duba wace jarabawa jiharku ke amfani da ita.
A ged.com, an rubuta cewa jarabawar Social Studies minti 70 ce ba tare da hutu ba. Tana da fannonin ƙwarewa uku: karatu don fahimtar ma'ana a nazarin zamantakewa, nazarin abubuwan tarihi da hujjoji, da amfani da lambobi da jadawali a nazarin zamantakewa. Tambayoyin zaɓi ne (multiple choice), cike gurbi, ja ka sauke (drag and drop), zaɓar wani yanki, da jerin zaɓi (drop-down).
Ana ba ku na'urar lissafi a kan allo da takardar bayanin na'urar lissafi, kuma ged.com ya ce kuna iya kawo na'urar lissafinku ta TI-30XS zuwa cibiyar jarabawa. Ged.com ya ce ba jarabawar haddace ba ce: kuna amfani da bayanan da aka ba ku don yanke ƙarshe.
Ged.com ya jera maki 145 a matsayin makin cin kowane fanni. Lokuta da ƙa'idoji suna iya canjawa, don haka ku duba ged.com kafin ku yi rajista. Ged.com yana da jarabawowin gwaji kyauta da jarabawar gwaji ta hukuma, GED Ready.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku je ged.com ku karanta shafin jarabawar Social Studies.
- Ku rubuta lokacin, fannonin ƙwarewa uku da kayan aikin da ake ba ku.
- Ku yi jarabawar gwajin Social Studies kyauta don ku ga matsayinku.
- Ku zaɓi makon da kuke son zama jarabawar.
- Ku rubuta aƙalla ranar karatu ɗaya a kowane mako, da ƙwarewar da za ku yi atisaye.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- GED: jarabawar daidai da sakandare; cin dukkan fannoni huɗu yana ba da takardar shaida da masu ɗaukar aiki da kwalejoji da yawa ke karɓa kamar takardar kammala sakandare.
- HiSET: wata jarabawar daidai da sakandare da wasu jihohi ke amfani da ita.
- Civics (ilimin zama ɗan ƙasa): nazarin gwamnati da haƙƙoƙi da ayyukan 'yan ƙasa.
- Economics (tattalin arziki): nazarin yadda mutane ke yi, saya, sayar da kuma amfani da kayayyaki da kuɗi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- GED Testing Service: fannonin jarabawa (lokaci, nau'o'in tambayoyi, na'urar lissafi)
- GED Testing Service: jarabawar Social Studies (Nazarin Zamantakewa)
- GED Testing Service: maki
- GED Testing Service: jarabawowin gwaji kyauta (Turanci da Sifaniyanci)
- GED Ready, jarabawar gwaji ta hukuma
- HiSET, wata jarabawar daidai da sakandare (shafin hukuma)
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe ged.com ku yi jarabawar gwajin Social Studies kyauta (ko ku karanta shafin Social Studies idan ba za ku iya yi yanzu ba). Ku rubuta tsarin karatunku: makon da kuke son zama jarabawa da rana ɗaya a kowane mako da ƙwarewar da za ku yi atisaye: karanta majiyoyi, gwamnati, tarihi, ko jadawali. Ku ajiye shi don aikin ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya ambaci sassa da kayan aikin jarabawar GED ta Social Studies, da bin tsarin karatu mai ranaku.

check.q: Me ged.com ya ce game da jarabawar Social Studies?
options: Game da wasu ƙasashe ne kawai
check.why: Ged.com ya ce ba jarabawar haddace ba ce; kuna tunani da bayanan da aka ba ku.

check.q: Wanne ne ɗaya daga cikin fannonin ƙwarewa uku na jarabawar?
options: Amfani da lambobi da jadawali a nazarin zamantakewa
check.why: Ged.com ya jera karatu don fahimtar ma'ana, abubuwan tarihi da hujjoji, da lambobi da jadawali.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Majiyoyi, mahanga, gaskiya da ra'ayi
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Gane babban ra'ayi, mahanga, gaskiya da ra'ayoyi a cikin majiya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku majiya ta farko ko ta biyu, za ku iya gane babban ra'ayi, mahangar marubuci, da waɗanne maganganu gaskiya ne da waɗanne ra'ayi ne, kuna nuna kalmomin da ke tabbatar da kowace amsa.
Majiya ta farko (primary source) wanda yake wurin a lokacin ne ya yi ta: wasiƙa, jawabi, doka, hoto, littafin tarihin yau da kullum. Majiya ta biyu (secondary source) wani ne ya yi ta daga baya yana nazarin abin da ya faru, kamar littafin karatu ko sharhin labarai. Dukansu suna da amfani; majiyoyi na farko suna nuna yadda mutane suka ga abubuwa a lokacin.
Mahanga (point of view) ita ce yadda marubuci yake ganin batun, bisa ko wane ne shi da abin da yake so. Ku tambaya: wa ya rubuta wannan, yaushe, kuma me yasa? Mai masana'anta da ma'aikacin masana'anta a shekarar 1900 suna iya bayyana yajin aiki ɗaya ta hanyoyi daban-daban sosai.
Gaskiya (fact) ana iya dubawa a tabbatar da ita gaskiya ce ko ƙarya: "An amince da Gyara na 19 (19th Amendment) a 1920." Ra'ayi (opinion) imani ne ko ji: "Shi ne canji mafi muhimmanci a tarihinmu." Kalmomi kamar mafi kyau, mafi muni, ya kamata, muhimmi da na yi imani sau da yawa suna nuna ra'ayi.
Misalin da aka warware. Tallar jarida ta 1910: "Sababbin injinanmu suna yin riguna 500 a rana. Kowane iyali na zamani ya kamata ya sayi rigunanmu!" Gaskiya: riguna 500 a rana (ana iya dubawa). Ra'ayi: kowane iyali ya kamata ya saye su. Mahanga: kamfani da ke sayar da kayansa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku tambaya wa ya yi majiyar, yaushe kuma me yasa.
- Ku yanke: ta farko (an yi ta a lokacin) ko ta biyu (an yi ta daga baya).
- Ku faɗi babban ra'ayi a jimla ɗaya.
- Ku yi wa kowace magana alama: gaskiya (ana iya dubawa) ko ra'ayi (imani ko hukunci).
- Ku bayyana mahangar marubuci da abin da yake son mai karatu ya yi ko ya yi tunani.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Majiya ta farko (primary source): abin da aka yi a lokacin wani abu ya faru, wanda yake wurin ne ya yi shi.
- Majiya ta biyu (secondary source): abin da aka yi daga baya, wani da ke nazarin abin da ya faru ne ya yi shi.
- Mahanga (point of view): yadda marubuci yake ganin batu, bisa ko wane ne shi da abin da yake so.
- Gaskiya (fact): maganar da ana iya dubawa a tabbatar da ita.
- Ra'ayi (opinion): imani, ji ko hukunci.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye: wasiƙar wani manomi a 1935: "Guguwar ƙura ta binne gonakinmu sau uku a wannan bazara. Ya kamata gwamnati ta taimaki manoma irinmu kafin lokaci ya ƙure." 1) Ta farko ko ta biyu? 2) Gaskiya ɗaya. 3) Ra'ayi ɗaya. 4) Mahanga? Amsoshi: 1) Ta farko: wanda yake wurin ne ya rubuta ta a lokacin. 2) Guguwar ƙura ta binne gonakin sau uku a wannan bazara. 3) Ya kamata gwamnati ta taimaki manoma. 4) Manomi mai fama da wahala yana neman taimako.
Yanzu za ku iya bambanta majiyoyi na farko da na biyu, bayyana mahanga, da rarraba gaskiya da ra'ayi.

check.q: Wace ce majiya ta farko game da Yaƙin Duniya na Biyu?
options: Taƙaitaccen bayani a shafin intanet da aka rubuta bara
Wasiƙar da wani soja ya rubuta gida a 1944
check.why: Wanda yake wurin ne ya yi ta a lokacin.

options: Majalisa (Congress) ta zartar da dokar a 1964.
Wannan ita ce doka mafi kyau da Majalisa ta taɓa zartarwa.
check.why: "Mafi kyau" hukunci ne da ba za a iya tabbatarwa ba.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Yadda gwamnatin Amurka ke aiki
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Bayyana wace reshen gwamnati ke aiki a wani yanayi da yadda bincike da daidaito ke aiki.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku gajeren yanayi na harkokin gwamnati, za ku iya bayyana wace reshen gwamnati ke aiki da yadda bincike da daidaito (checks and balances) ko wani haƙƙi na kundin tsarin mulki ya shafi lamarin, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
Kundin Tsarin Mulkin Amurka (Constitution) ya raba gwamnatin tarayya zuwa rassa uku don kada wani mutum ko ƙungiya ta mallaki iko da yawa. Reshen majalisa (legislative) shi ne Congress (Majalisar Dattawa, Senate, da Majalisar Wakilai, House of Representatives); yana yin dokoki. Reshen zartarwa (executive) shi ne shugaban ƙasa, mataimakinsa da majalisar ministoci (cabinet); yana aiwatar da dokoki. Reshen shari'a (judicial) shi ne Kotun Ƙoli (Supreme Court) da sauran kotunan tarayya; suna fassara dokoki kuma suna yanke ko sun saɓa wa Kundin Tsarin Mulki.
Bincike da daidaito (checks and balances) suna bar kowane reshe ya taƙaita sauran. Shugaban ƙasa yana iya hawa kujerar na-ƙi (veto) kan ƙudurin da Majalisa ta zartar. Majalisar Dattawa tana amincewa ko ƙin waɗanda shugaban ƙasa ya zaɓa, kamar alƙalan tarayya. Kotun Ƙoli tana iya soke dokar da ta ga ta saɓa wa Kundin Tsarin Mulki. Majalisa tana iya, a lokuta masu tsanani, cire shugaban ƙasa daga mulki.
Bill of Rights (Kundin Haƙƙoƙi) su ne gyare-gyare goma na farko ga Kundin Tsarin Mulki. Yana kare haƙƙoƙi kamar 'yancin faɗin albarkacin baki, addini, 'yan jarida da taruwa (Gyara na Farko, First Amendment), da haƙƙoƙin mutanen da ake zargi da laifi, kamar shari'a mai adalci kuma cikin sauri. Ana kuma raba iko tsakanin gwamnatin tarayya da jihohi; ana kiran wannan tsarin tarayya (federalism).
Misalin da aka warware. "Majalisa ta zartar da ƙuduri. Shugaban ƙasa ya hau kujerar na-ƙi." Wane bincike ne wannan? Reshen zartarwa ne ke taƙaita reshen majalisa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku gano wa ke aiki: Majalisa, shugaban ƙasa ko kotu.
- Ku ambaci reshen: majalisa, zartarwa ko shari'a.
- Ku tambaya wane iko ake amfani da shi: yin, aiwatarwa ko fassara dokoki.
- Idan wani reshe yana taƙaita wani, ku ambaci binciken.
- Idan haƙƙoƙin wani mutum sun shafi lamarin, ku nemi haƙƙin a cikin Bill of Rights.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Constitution (Kundin Tsarin Mulki): doka mafi girma a Amurka; ita ce ta kafa gwamnati.
- Reshen majalisa (legislative branch): Congress; yana yin dokoki.
- Reshen zartarwa (executive branch): shugaban ƙasa, mataimakinsa da majalisar ministoci; yana aiwatar da dokoki.
- Reshen shari'a (judicial branch): kotuna; suna fassara dokoki.
- Veto (kujerar na-ƙi): lokacin da shugaban ƙasa ya ƙi ƙudurin da Majalisa ta zartar.
- Amendment (gyara): canji ko ƙari ga Kundin Tsarin Mulki.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USAGov: Rassan gwamnatin Amurka
- National Archives: Kundin Tsarin Mulkin Amurka (cikakken rubutu)
- National Archives: Bill of Rights (cikakken rubutu)
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye: ku ambaci reshen ko haƙƙin. 1) Majalisar Dattawa ta kaɗa ƙuri'a kan wanda shugaban ƙasa ya zaɓa ya zama alƙalin tarayya. 2) Kotun Ƙoli ta yanke cewa wata doka ta saɓa wa Kundin Tsarin Mulki. 3) Wata jarida ta buga labarin da ke sukar magajin gari. 4) Shugaban ƙasa ya sa hannu a ƙuduri ya zama doka. Amsoshi: 1) Majalisa ce ke taƙaita zartarwa. 2) Shari'a ce ke taƙaita majalisa. 3) 'Yancin 'yan jarida, Gyara na Farko. 4) Zartarwa (tana yin aikinta wajen yin doka).
Yanzu za ku iya ambaci rassa uku, bayyana bincike da daidaito a wani yanayi, da haɗa wani lamari da Bill of Rights.

check.q: Wane reshe ne ke yin dokokin tarayya?
check.why: Congress, reshen majalisa, ce ke yin dokoki.

check.q: Kotun Ƙoli ta yanke cewa wata doka ta saɓa wa Kundin Tsarin Mulki. Misalin me ne wannan?
options: Binciken da reshen shari'a ke yi wa reshen majalisa
check.why: Kotuna suna iya soke dokokin da suka saɓa wa Kundin Tsarin Mulki.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Tarihi, tattalin arziki da jadawali

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Dalili, sakamako da shaida a tarihi
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Gane dalili da sakamako a wani abin tarihi da shaidar da ke goyon bayan wata fahimta.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku wani abin tarihi ko hujja, za ku iya gane dalili da sakamako, da shaidar da ke goyon bayan wata fahimta (inference), kuna ambaton shaidar daga majiyar.
Tambayoyin tarihi sau da yawa suna tambayar me yasa wani abu ya faru (dalili) da me ya faru saboda shi (sakamako). Kalmomin alama: saboda, don haka, a sakamakon haka, ya kai ga, saboda haka, sanadiyyar.
Misalin da aka warware. "A ƙarshen shekarun 1800, masana'antu a birane sun ba da sababbin ayyuka da yawa. A sakamakon haka, miliyoyin mutane sun ƙaura daga gonaki zuwa birane. Yawan mutanen birane ya ƙaru da sauri, kuma cunkoson gidaje ya zama matsala." Dalili: ayyukan masana'antu a birane. Sakamako: mutane sun ƙaura zuwa birane. Sakamako na gaba: cunkoson gidaje. Dalili ɗaya yana iya kawo jerin sakamako.
Fahimta (inference) ƙarshe ne da shaida ke goyon baya. Tambayoyin GED suna iya tambayar wace magana daga majiya ke goyon bayan wata fahimta. Ku zaɓi maganar da ke ba da hujja, ba wadda kawai take magana kan batu ɗaya ba.
Ku yi hankali: abubuwa biyu da suka faru a lokaci ɗaya ba koyaushe yana nufin ɗaya ne ya kawo ɗayan ba. Ku nemi majiyar ta faɗa ko ta nuna alaƙar.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku nemo abin da tambayar take magana a kai.
- Ku nemi kalmomin alama: saboda, don haka, a sakamakon haka, ya kai ga.
- Ku ambaci dalilin (me yasa) da sakamakon (me ya faru na gaba).
- Don fahimta, ku zaɓi maganar da ke ba da hujja a kanta.
- Ku duba cewa majiyar ta haɗa abubuwan biyu da gaske; kada ku yi zato.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Dalili (cause): me yasa wani abu ya faru.
- Sakamako (effect): abin da ya faru saboda dalilin.
- Fahimta (inference): ƙarshen da shaida ke goyon baya.
- Industrialization (bunƙasar masana'antu): ƙaruwar masana'antu da injina da ke yin kayayyaki.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye: "Dust Bowl (Kwanon Ƙura) na shekarun 1930 ya lalata amfanin gona a Great Plains (Manyan Filaye). Iyalan manoma da yawa sun rasa ƙasarsu kuma sun ƙaura zuwa yamma don neman aiki." 1) Dalili? 2) Sakamako? 3) Wace magana ce ta fi goyon bayan fahimtar "Dust Bowl ya canja inda mutane ke zama": (a) "Dust Bowl ya lalata amfanin gona" ko (b) "Iyalan manoma da yawa sun ƙaura zuwa yamma"? Amsoshi: 1) Guguwar ƙura ta lalata amfanin gona. 2) Iyalai sun rasa ƙasa kuma sun ƙaura zuwa yamma. 3) (b): tana nuna mutane suna ƙaura.
Yanzu za ku iya gano dalilai da sakamako a tarihi, da zaɓar shaidar da ke goyon bayan wata fahimta.

check.q: "Farashin man fetur ya hau sosai, don haka mutane da yawa suka hau bas." Mene ne sakamakon?
options: Mutane da yawa sun hau bas
check.why: Hawan bas shi ne abin da ya faru saboda farashin man fetur ya hau.

check.q: Wace magana ce ta fi goyon bayan fahimtar cewa sabuwar babbar hanya ta taimaki kasuwancin wani gari?
options: "Cinikin shaguna a garin ya ninka a cikin shekaru biyar bayan buɗe babbar hanyar."
check.why: Tana ba da shaidar bunƙasar kasuwanci mai alaƙa da babbar hanyar.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Tattalin arziki da jadawali
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Karanta tebur ko taswira, bayyana yanayin canji da zaɓar ƙarshen da bayanan suka goyi baya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku taswira, tebur ko jadawali game da tarihi, tattalin arziki ko labarin ƙasa, za ku iya karanta ƙima, bayyana yanayin canji (trend) da zaɓar ƙarshen da bayanan suka goyi baya, ba tare da ƙara bayanan da ba a nuna ba.
Wadata (supply) ita ce yawan abin da ake sayarwa. Buƙata (demand) ita ce yawan abin da mutane ke son saya. Idan buƙata ta ƙaru kuma wadata ta tsaya yadda take, farashi yawanci yana hawa. Idan wadata ta ƙaru kuma buƙata ta tsaya yadda take, farashi yawanci yana sauka. Misali: bayan sanyi mai tsanani ya lalata amfanin lemu, wadatar lemu tana raguwa kuma farashi yana hawa.
Jadawali: ku fara karanta take, alamomi da ma'auni. Teburin atisaye (ƙirƙirarre): yawan marasa aikin yi a wani birni ya kasance 8% a 2020, 6% a 2021, 5% a 2022 da 4% a 2023. Yanayin canji: yana sauka kowace shekara. Ƙarshen da aka goyi baya: kaso kaɗan na masu neman aiki ba su da aiki a 2023 fiye da 2020. Wanda ba a goyi baya ba: me yasa ya sauka, domin teburin bai faɗa ba.
Taswira: ku karanta take, legend (makullin bayani) da alamar kwatance (compass rose). Legend yana faɗa muku abin da launuka ko alamomi ke nufi. Taswirar ruwan sama tana iya amfani da launuka masu duhu don ruwan sama mai yawa. Ku yi amfani da ma'aunin nisa (scale) don ƙiyasta nisa.
Canjin kaso ya zama ruwan dare: daga 8% zuwa 4% raguwa ce ta maki 4 na kaso (percentage points). Kuna iya amfani da na'urar lissafi a kan allo don lissafin.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku karanta take, alamomi, ma'auni ko legend na taswira.
- Ku nemo ƙimar da tambayar ke nema.
- Ku bayyana yanayin canji: yana hawa, yana sauka ko babu tsari a sarari.
- Ku zaɓi ƙarshen da ya tsaya cikin bayanan.
- Don farashi, ku tambaya: wadata ko buƙata ce ta canja?
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Wadata (supply): yawan kaya ko hidimar da ake sayarwa.
- Buƙata (demand): yawan abin da mutane ke son saya.
- Yawan marasa aikin yi (unemployment rate): kason masu neman aiki da ba su da aiki.
- Legend (makullin bayani): makullin taswira ko tebur da ke faɗin abin da launuka ko alamomi ke nufi.
- Maki na kaso (percentage point): bambanci kai tsaye tsakanin kaso biyu, kamar daga 8% zuwa 4% maki 4 ne.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (bayanan ƙirƙirarru): jadawalin sanduna yana nuna matsakaicin kuɗin hayar wata-wata a wani birni: 2019: $1,000; 2021: $1,150; 2023: $1,400. 1) Kuɗin haya a 2021? 2) Yanayin canji? 3) Nawa kuɗin haya ya ƙaru daga 2019 zuwa 2023? 4) Wane ƙarshe ne aka goyi baya: (a) kuɗin haya ya ƙaru a wannan lokaci, ko (b) kuɗin haya ya ƙaru saboda sababbin ayyuka? Amsoshi: 1) $1,150. 2) Yana hawa. 3) $400. 4) (a); jadawalin bai nuna me yasa ba.
Yanzu za ku iya amfani da wadata da buƙata don bayanin canjin farashi, da karanta teburori da taswira don zaɓar ƙarshen da aka goyi baya.

check.q: Guguwa ta lalata masana'antun katako da yawa, don haka katakon da ake sayarwa ya ragu yayin da magina har yanzu suna son sa. Me yawanci yake faruwa ga farashin katako?
check.why: Wadata ta ragu yayin da buƙata ta tsaya yadda take, don haka farashi yawanci yana hawa.

check.q: A kan taswira, me ke faɗa muku abin da kowane launi ke nufi?
check.why: Legend yana bayanin launuka da alamomi.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Haɗa komai: nazarin takardar kafuwar ƙasa
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Cike takardar nazarin majiya kan takardar kafuwar ƙasa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku majiya ta farko ko ta biyu, za ku iya gane babban ra'ayi, mahangar marubuci, da waɗanne maganganu gaskiya ne da waɗanne ra'ayi ne, kuna nuna kalmomin da ke tabbatar da kowace amsa. Idan aka ba ku gajeren yanayi na harkokin gwamnati, za ku iya bayyana wace reshen gwamnati ke aiki da yadda bincike da daidaito (checks and balances) ko wani haƙƙi na kundin tsarin mulki ya shafi lamarin, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai. Idan aka ba ku wani abin tarihi ko hujja, za ku iya gane dalili da sakamako, da shaidar da ke goyon bayan wata fahimta (inference), kuna ambaton shaidar daga majiyar.
Tambayoyin GED sau da yawa suna ba ku ɗan guntun tsohuwar takarda kuma suna tambaya game da babban ra'ayinta, manufarta ko yadda take da alaƙa da gwamnati a yau. Preamble, jimlar farko ta Kundin Tsarin Mulki, abu ne mai kyau don atisaye. Ku karanta ta a shafin National Archives.
Preamble tana farawa da "We the People of the United States" (Mu Jama'ar Ƙasar Amurka) kuma tana jera buri: kafa haɗin kai mafi kyau, tabbatar da adalci, tabbatar da zaman lafiya a cikin gida (domestic tranquility), samar da tsaron bai ɗaya, bunƙasa jin daɗin kowa (general welfare) da tabbatar da albarkun 'yanci.
Nazarin da aka warware. Wa da yaushe: wakilai a Babban Taron Kundin Tsarin Mulki (Constitutional Convention), 1787. Nau'i: majiya ta farko. Babban ra'ayi: jama'a sun kafa gwamnati don cimma buri na bai ɗaya. Mahanga: shugabanni da ke son gwamnatin ƙasa mai ƙarfi fiye da wadda suke da ita a baya. Dalili da sakamako: gwamnatin farko ƙarƙashin Articles of Confederation tana da rauni, wanda ya kai ga rubuta sabon Kundin Tsarin Mulki. Rassa: Preamble tana gabatar da dukan Kundin Tsarin Mulki, wanda ya kafa dukkan rassa uku.
Takardarku ba ta buƙatar cikakkun amsoshi ba tare da kuskure ba. Tana buƙatar amsoshin da za ku iya tabbatarwa ta hanyar nuna kalmomin da ke cikin takardar.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe rubutun Kundin Tsarin Mulki a archives.gov ku karanta Preamble.
- Ku rubuta wa ya rubuta ta, yaushe, da ko ta farko ce ko ta biyu.
- Ku rubuta babban ra'ayi a jimla ɗaya da mahangar.
- Ku rubuta gaskiya ɗaya game da ita da buri ko ra'ayi ɗaya da ke cikinta.
- Ku rubuta dalili ɗaya da sakamako ɗaya, da reshe ko haƙƙin da take da alaƙa da shi.
- Ku ƙara tsarin karatunku mai ranaku a ƙasa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Preamble (gabatarwa): jimlar farko ta Kundin Tsarin Mulki da ke faɗin manufarsa.
- Articles of Confederation: tsarin farko na gwamnatin Amurka, wanda aka yi amfani da shi kafin Kundin Tsarin Mulki.
- Domestic tranquility: zaman lafiya a cikin gida.
- General welfare: jin daɗin dukan jama'a.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- National Archives: Kundin Tsarin Mulkin Amurka (cikakken rubutu)
- National Archives: Bill of Rights (cikakken rubutu)
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku cike takardar nazarin majiya mai shafi ɗaya kan Preamble (ko Bill of Rights) daga archives.gov, ta amfani da matakan da ke sama. Ku ƙara tsarin karatun GED naku mai ranaku a ƙasa, sannan ku ba aikinku maki da ma'aunin rubric na kwas ɗin.
Yanzu za ku iya nazarin takardar kafuwar ƙasa: nau'in majiyarta, babban ra'ayi, mahanga, dalilai da sakamako, da alaƙarta da yadda gwamnati ke aiki.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Majiya da mahanga Nau'in majiya ko marubuci ba daidai ba ne ko babu. Marubuci, rana da nau'in majiya daidai, da mahangar da ta dace da wanda ya rubuta da dalilinsa. Yana kuma bayanin yadda mahangar ke tsara abin da takardar ke faɗa. Babban ra'ayi, gaskiya da ra'ayi Babban ra'ayi ba daidai ba ne, ko an haɗa gaskiya da ra'ayi. Babban ra'ayi daidai a jimla ɗaya, gaskiya ɗaya da buri ko ra'ayi ɗaya, kowanne an haɗa shi da kalmomin. Yana kawo ainihin kalmomin da ke nuna kowace amsa. Dalili da sakamako Babu dalili ko sakamako, ko an juya su. Dalili ɗaya daidai da sakamako ɗaya daidai masu alaƙa da takardar. Yana nuna jeri: dalili, sakamako da sakamako na gaba. Alaƙa da gwamnati Ba a ambaci reshe ko haƙƙi ba, ko an ambaci wanda ba daidai ba. Yana ambaton reshe ko haƙƙin da take da alaƙa da shi kuma yana bayanin dalili a jimla ɗaya. Yana kuma ba da misalin bincike da daidaito ko wani haƙƙi da ake amfani da shi a yau. Karanta bayanai Bai kammala atisayen jadawali na Darasi na 5 ba. Ya kammala atisayen jadawali na Darasi na 5 da ƙarshen da ya tsaya cikin bayanan. Yana kuma bayanin canjin farashi ta amfani da wadata da buƙata. Tsarin karatu Babu tsarin karatu, ko babu ranaku. Tsarin karatu da aƙalla rana ɗaya a kowane mako har zuwa makon jarabawa. Yana kuma da ranar GED Ready ko ranar jarabawa da aka yi rajista. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku sake karanta wannan sashe na takardar ku gyara amsarku.

check.q: Wakilai a Babban Taron Kundin Tsarin Mulki ne suka rubuta Preamble a 1787. Wace irin majiya ce?
check.why: Mutanen da suka rubuta Kundin Tsarin Mulki ne suka yi ta a lokacin.

check.q: Articles of Confederation sun kafa gwamnatin ƙasa mai rauni. Mene ne ɗaya daga cikin sakamakon?
options: Shugabanni sun rubuta sabon Kundin Tsarin Mulki
check.why: Raunin Articles ya kai ga Kundin Tsarin Mulki na 1787.
